reported_status: Completed source-exposed internal review of the named conditional construction. proof_availability.classification_scope: Actual terminal QND measurement followed by ancilla discard yields 4*2^m positive logical-error/syndrome task weights even with continuing quantum memory. Paired weak audits acquire a visited-history task mixture without error labels. Frozen weights generate exact integer full-record recovery and a bounded adaptive readout stopping when perfect remaining syndrome information cannot improve modeled repair by more than epsilon. Its model-average regret is at most epsilon+m*t_L; fresh whole-macro secret-slot verification separately bounds accepted bad CP weight uniformly in the continuing memory. Fixed-budget task-model renewal does not simulate the complete environment or certify an infinite output stream.
